# spx_load_balancer (Resource)

Manages a Load Balancer on SPX.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the Load Balancer.
- `vip` (String) The Virtual IP of the Load Balancer.

### Optional

- `az` (String) The availability zone of the Load Balancer. If not set, the provider value is used.
- `endpoints` (List of String) The list of IP endpoints.
- `orga_id` (String) The organization ID. If not set, the provider value is used.
- `ports` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--ports))
- `project_id` (String) The project ID. If not set, the provider value is used.
- `selectors` (List of String) The list of selectors (key:value).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the Load Balancer.

<a id="nestedblock--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ports`

Required:

- `port` (Number)
- `protocol` (String)
- `target_port` (Number)

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The name of the port (computed).
